The TR / EN switch changes the interface language. Data you entered, such as project and customer names, is not translated.
Anahtar teslim GES teklifi altı adımda h: A turnkey PV quote is prepared in six steps: Project info → Technical → Survey-A → Survey-B → Timeline → Analysis. Each step is saved with “Save & Continue”, which unlocks the next tab.
Sol menüden Teklifler → “Yeni Proje”ye t: From the left menu click Quotes → “New Project”. Choose “Turnkey” for a full PV EPC quote, or “Material & Service” for a simple material or service quote.
Proje adı, il / ilçe, kurulum tipi (çatı: Enter the project name, province / district, installation type (rooftop or ground) and customer. Saved customers are listed as you type; if not listed, a new customer is added.
Müşteriyi listeden seçin: Pick the customer from the list
Açılan listeden müşteriyi seçince iletiş: Selecting a customer fills in the contact details automatically. What you write in the notes and risks fields appears in the quote PDF.
DC/AC güç, panel ve inverter gücü ile in: Enter DC/AC capacity, panel and inverter ratings and the number of inverters. The panel count is calculated from DC capacity and panel rating; required (starred) fields must be filled to continue.
“Güncel kuru çek” USD ve EUR kurunu otom: “Fetch current rate” loads USD and EUR rates automatically. The start date and construction period set the number of months in Cash Flow and Timeline.
Zorunlu alanlar dolunca “Kaydet & İlerle: Once required fields are filled, “Save & Continue” is enabled. On save, Survey-A quantities are recalculated from these technical values.
Panel, inverter, konstrüksiyon, kablo ve: Panel, inverter, mounting, cable and labour items come ready in 18 groups. Quantities are calculated from the capacity entered on the technical page; unit price and currency can be changed.
Personel, işletme-bakım, risk, teminat v: Enter staff, O&M, risk, guarantee and insurance costs. B.6 Financing Cost is calculated automatically from the loan interest on the Cash Flow page; it is not typed in.
Avans, hakediş ve iş sonu tahsilatları i: Advance, progress and completion collections and the monthly spread of each cost group are entered as percentages. “Spread evenly” splits the selected group equally; each row must total 100%.
Timeline kaydedildiğinde Analiz sekmesi: When the Timeline is saved, the Analysis tab opens: total EPC sales price, $/kWp, gross margin and cost breakdown on a single screen.
Kaydedilmiş bir anahtar teslim teklifin: All tabs of a saved turnkey quote: cost items, margin settings, cash flow and customer documents. Example: Polatlı 10 MWp ground-mounted PV.
Teklif açıldığında üstte sekmeler sırala: When a quote opens, tabs line up at the top. Input (Project, Technical, Survey-A/B, Timeline), decision (Analysis, Cash Flow) and output (BoQ, P-BoQ, DoR) tabs are colour-coded.
Her grubun toplamı ve $/Wp birim maliyet: Each group's total and $/Wp unit cost appear in its header. Changing an item's quantity or price updates totals instantly.
Üstte toplam EPC satış fiyatı, USD/kWp v: At the top: total EPC sales price, USD/kWp and gross margin. Contingency, overhead and net profit rates change with the ±0.5 buttons; the price updates live.
Panel, konstrüksiyon ve inverter için ta: Defined alternatives for panels, mounting and inverters are listed side by side. Clicking one shows its effect (+/−) on the total and recalculates the quote with it.
Grup bazında maliyet, payı ve satıştaki: Cost, share and percentage of sales per group. Click a group to edit quantities and prices here; changes carry over to the Survey pages.
“Diğer Detaylar” bölümünde maliyet dağıl: “Other Details” holds the cost breakdown, donut chart, cash flow, FX sensitivity and profitability analysis. Clicking a slice opens that group's items.
Aylık giriş ve çıkışlar, kümülatif nakit: Monthly inflows and outflows, cumulative cash position and borrowing need. Interest is calculated for negative months and the total financing cost is written to item B.6 in Survey-B.

Tedarik, montaj ve devreye alma işlerini: Defines item by item whether supply, installation and commissioning are the contractor's, the employer's or shared responsibility. Groups and items can be added or removed.

“Öde” penceresinde tutar yazılır ya da “: In the “Pay” dialog type an amount or fill the full balance with “Enter remaining”; choose the date and method. The amount is allocated to the supplier's items by remaining balance.
Ödeme kaydedilince tedarikçinin kalan bo: Once saved, the supplier's balance drops to zero, the item becomes “Paid” and the “Owed to Suppliers” card updates.
Faturalı ve faturasız satış ayrılarak öd: Separating invoiced and uninvoiced sales, VAT payable, corporate tax and net profit retained are calculated step by step.
Tedarikçilerin vergi numarası, IBAN ve ö: Suppliers' tax numbers, IBANs and payment accounts are kept here and selected from the list when adding items.
Customers are created automatically from quotes. The material catalogue holds the unpriced item definitions used in Material & Service quotes.
Müşteriler iletişim bilgisi, teklif sayı: Customers are listed with contact details, number of quotes and insight notes. New customers are added from the customer box when creating a quote; “Go” opens the customer page.
Müşterinin tüm teklifleri, iletişim bilg: All of a customer's quotes, contact details and quote notes on one page.
Malzemeler MLZ, hizmetler HZM koduyla tu: Materials use MLZ codes, services HZM codes. Prices go into quotes, not the catalogue; you can see at what price each item was quoted where.
Tür (malzeme / hizmet), ad ve birim giri: Enter type (material / service), name and unit; the code is assigned by type (MLZ… / HZM…).
Yeni kalem sıradaki kodla kataloğa eklen: The item gets the next code and is immediately searchable in Material & Service quotes. Edit or delete it with the row buttons.
Ekip toplantıları, saha ziyaretleri, gör: Team meetings, site visits, tasks and reminders in one calendar. Events can be linked to a quote; reminders arrive as notifications.
Etkinlikler türüne göre renkli işaretlen: Events are colour-coded by type. Filters at the top show only meetings, tasks or visits; follow-up dates from the Notebook also appear.
“+ Etkinlik” ile başlık, tür, tarih-saat: “+ Event” takes a title, type, date-time, location, attendees, visibility and reminder. On the time grid at the right, drag the block to set the time and pull its edges to set the duration in 10-minute steps.
Kaydedilen etkinlik takvimde görünür; üz: The saved event appears in the calendar; click it to edit. At the reminder time a notification arrives on the bell.
Hafta görünümü haftanın yedi gününü yan: The week view shows seven days side by side with each day's events in time order. Use the arrows to move between weeks.
Gün görünümü seçili günün etkinliklerini: The day view lists the selected day's events and Notebook actions in time order.
Önümüzdeki 30 günün etkinlikleri liste h: Events for the next 30 days as a list, day by day.
Toplantı notları, kararlar, aksiyon plan: Meeting notes, decisions, action plans, contacts and companies in a personal notebook. Notes can be downloaded as PDF, shared via WhatsApp or email, or copied as text.
Notlar kart olarak, aya göre gruplanarak: Notes are listed as cards grouped by month; pinned notes stay on top. The “To-dos” bar collects open actions from all notes. Search by company, person, tag or text.
Her not konu başlıkları, alınan kararlar: Each note holds topics, decisions and an action plan with owner and due date; the follow-up date goes to the calendar. Buttons at the top download it as PDF or share it via WhatsApp or email.
“Yeni Not” ile başlık, tarih, tür ve fir: “New Note” takes a title, date, type and company. The company is chosen from saved companies, or saved as a new one.
Sağ tarafta görüşülen her konu için özet: On the right, write a summary and decisions for each topic; add tasks with owner and due date to the action plan. “Save” stores the note.
Kaydedilen not, yazdırılabilir toplantı: The saved note opens as printable meeting minutes. Its open action is added to the To-dos bar on the Notes tab; change it with “Edit”.
Görevler sekmesinde hızlı görevler tarih: The Tasks tab keeps quick tasks with dates, filtered as open, today, overdue and done. Click the circle to complete a task.

Tasarım adı ve konumu girilip “Oluştur &: Enter a design name and location and press “Create & Open”. The editor has four steps: Image & Scale, Building & Roof, Panel Layout and Analysis; each unlocks when the previous one is done.

“Haritadan Al (uydu)” ile harita açılır;: “From Map (satellite)” opens the map; search an address or building and select the result. Centre and zoom in on the building (zoom 20+) and press “Take This View”. Scale is computed from the map.
Alınan görüntüde köşeler sürüklenerek bi: Drag the corners to frame the building and press “Crop & Use”. A drone image or screenshot can be uploaded instead.
Kırpılan görüntü ölçekli altlık olur; sa: The cropped image becomes the scaled base; the panel on the right shows the scale (1 m = … px). “Continue” moves to the building step.
“Boş Çiz” ile binanın dış hattı köşe köş: With “Free Draw” click the outline corner by corner; returning to the first corner closes the shape. Ready shapes (rectangle, L, T, U…) can be added and placed with “Move”. The roof is generated from the outline.
Seçili kütle için duvar yüksekliği, çatı: Set wall height, roof type (flat, gable, hip, mono-pitch), pitch and parapet for the selected mass. Warehouses and factories usually use a flat roof.
Çatıyı kilitleyip panel yerleşimine geçi: Lock the roof and move to panel layout
“Tamamla & Kilitle” çatı modelini sabitl: “Finish & Lock” fixes the roof model and moves to panel layout. Pick a panel model from the catalogue or enter dimensions; set orientation, panel gaps, roof setback and row spacing.
“Panelleri Otomatik Yerleştir” çatıya sı: “Auto-place Panels” fits as many panels as the roof allows. Panels can be moved, rotated (R) or deleted (Del) one by one; draw a rectangle on empty space to multi-select.
“3B” düğmesi binayı, çatıyı ve panelleri: The “3D” button shows the building, roof and panels in 3D over the satellite image. Rotate with the mouse, zoom with the wheel.
Toplam panel sayısı, kurulu güç, özgül ü: Shows total panels, installed capacity, specific yield and approximate annual production. The estimate uses city-based specific yield.
Panel yöneticisi ekip arkadaşlarını dave: The panel admin invites teammates and sets their roles and project access, follows who-did-what logs and company performance, and configures the company identity on PDF outputs.
Paneldeki kişiler rolleriyle (Yönetici,: Panel members are listed with roles (Admin, User, Viewer). The shield icon hides projects or makes them read-only per person.
E-posta ve rol seçilip davet oluşturulur: Enter an email and role to create an invitation. The invitee receives an email and joins the panel after clicking the link and setting a password.
Panelde kimin ne zaman hangi kaydı değiş: Lists who changed which record and when. Logs cannot be deleted; filter by user, action and resource type. Click a row to see the change details.
Aylık teklif sayısı ve gücü, kazanma ora: Monthly quote count and capacity, win rate, average $/Wp, pending and completed revenue, a 12-month trend and salesperson ranking. “Annual Report” downloads as PDF.
Ad, şirket adı ve şifre değiştirilir; üy: Change your name, company name and password; your panels and switching between them are listed here.
Logo, kaşe, marka rengi, slogan, filigra: Logo, stamp, brand colour, slogan, watermark and bank details are applied to PDF and Excel outputs. “Preview” shows how the output will look.
Firma tanıtım PDF’i, referans listesi ve: Upload a company profile PDF, reference list and documents such as certificates; customers see them under the “Company” and “References” tabs of a share link.
